agentConfig.title: You have not created a single agent yet. Let's get started!
agentConfig.desc: A single agent is an AI entity centered around a large model, with independent perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. It can flexibly call RAG, plugins, MCP, and other diversified skills to meet users' complete task requirements.

one.title: Create a Single Agent
one.desc: Click to create a single agent, select the agent type, and fill in the basic information to complete the creation. You can also use AI to assist in creation.

two.title: Configure Capabilities
two.desc: Configure prompts, model services, skills, knowledge bases, and conversation experience to set up core capabilities.

three.title: Test and Run
three.desc: Simulate real-world conversations to verify the accuracy of the agent's responses. Support call chain tracing for targeted optimization of configurations.

four.title: Submit Version and Share
four.desc: After submitting the version, complete multi-channel sharing. Supports API, web, and other methods of invocation.

workflowConfig.title: You have not created a workflow yet. Let's get started!
workflowConfig.desc: A workflow automates business processes through visual orchestration, suitable for scenarios with fixed task flows.

one.title: Create a Workflow
one.desc: Click to create a workflow, select dialogue-type or task-type, and fill in the basic information to create it. Dialogue-type workflows can be created with AI assistance.

two.title: Configure Workflow Nodes
two.desc: Add and connect nodes according to the business process, and complete parameter and content configuration for each node.

three.title: Test and Run
three.desc: Simulate real-world conversations to verify the accuracy and completeness of the workflow's responses. View the call chain for targeted optimization of configurations.

four.title: Submit Version and Share
four.desc: After submitting the version, complete multi-channel sharing. Supports API, web, and other methods of invocation.

multiConfig.title: You have not created a multi-agent yet. Let's get started!
multiConfig.desc: A multi-agent application allows users to combine multiple agent applications or workflow applications and schedule them collaboratively according to preset modes. Suitable for scenarios that require multi-task processing.

one.title: Create a Multi-Agent
one.desc: Click to create a multi-agent, select the multi-agent type, and fill in the basic information to complete the creation.

two.title: Configure Controller
two.desc: Configure prompts, model services, sub-agents, sub-workflows, and other core capabilities.

three.title: Test and Run
three.desc: Simulate real-world conversations to verify the accuracy and completeness of the multi-agent's responses. View the call chain for targeted optimization of configurations.

four.title: Submit Version and Share
four.desc: After submitting the version, complete multi-channel sharing. Supports API, web, and other methods of invocation.

mcpConfig.title: You have not created an MCP yet. Let's get started!
mcpConfig.desc: Integrate tools and data services that comply with the MCP standard to quickly expand the agent's capabilities through a common protocol.

one.title: Create an MCP
one.desc: Select the creation type: blank creation, template creation, or third-party service installation.

two.title: Debug Parameters and Tools
two.desc: Provide debugging capabilities to ensure that the MCP integrated into the application is usable and correct, reducing the risks in application development and operations.

pluginConfig.title: You have not created a plugin yet. Let's get started!
pluginConfig.desc: Integrate API interfaces and third-party services to give agents the ability to call external tools for execution.

one.title: Create a Plugin
one.desc: Fill in the basic information and configure the protocol, domain, URL, parameters, and other settings to complete the creation.

two.title: Configure Tools
two.desc: Fill in the tool's basic information, support importing and parsing the tool URL, and expand the plugin's functionality.

three.title: Publish the Plugin
three.desc: Edit the version information, and after publishing, it can be called by agents and workflows.

promptConfig.title: You have not created a prompt yet. Let's get started!
promptConfig.desc: Uniformly manage prompt templates, support variable insertion and debugging, and can be reused in multiple scenarios such as agent personas or large model nodes in workflows.

one.title: Create a Prompt
one.desc: Click to create a new one or import. After selecting new, fill in the basic information and prompt content, and save to complete the creation.

two.title: Optimize the Prompt
two.desc: Select an existing prompt or create an optimization task, fill in the basic information, create a test set based on variables in the prompt, and configure the optimization strategy to submit the optimization task.

three.title: View Optimization Results
three.desc: View the results of each round of optimization, compare the results before and after optimization, and synchronize the best prompt to the prompt management list.

optimizeConfig.title: You haven't tuned the model yet. Let's get started!

one.title: Create Optimization Task
one.desc: Click to create an optimization task. Select the optimization object, method, and dataset to start the task.

two.title: Deploy and Access the Optimized Model
two.desc: Based on the model generated from the optimization task, select the best model output to complete model deployment and access.

three.title: Use the Optimized Model
three.desc: Once deployed and accessed successfully, the optimized model can be referenced by agents.

knowledgeConfig.title: You have not created a knowledge base yet. Let's get started!
knowledgeConfig.desc: Import business documents and data to provide private domain knowledge retrieval capabilities for agents, enabling accurate Q&A.

one.title: Create a Knowledge Base
one.desc: Select the creation type: default creation or external third-party knowledge base connection.

two.title: Upload Documents
two.desc: Upload files which are automatically sliced and stored in the database. You can perform hit tests to view RAG effects.

three.title: Set Enable/Disable Status
three.desc: After creation, it is enabled by default and can be called by applications. Switching to disabled will stop providing services to applications.

cardConfig.title: You have not created a card yet. Let's get started!
cardConfig.desc: Design rich interactive UI components to render forms, lists, and other visual interfaces in conversations.

one.title: Create a Card
one.desc: Fill in the card name, configure the resource URL and a recognizable card cover, and define metadata.

two.title: Card Publishing and Management
two.desc: Support publishing and updating, and view, restore, or delete published history.

three.title: View Reference Data
three.desc: Support viewing the card versions referenced by workflows, and easily locate and update the corresponding versions.

four.title: Associate with Application Nodes
four.desc: Workflow > Card Node > Bind a published card template to quickly call standardized card content.

intentManage.title: You have not created an intent package yet. Let's get started!
intentManage.desc: Define intent categories and examples to achieve accurate identification and routing of conversations.

one.title: Create an Intent Package
one.desc: Create new intent categories and examples, and you can enter them in bulk.

two.title: Reference in Workflows
two.desc: Workflow > Advanced Intent Recognition Node > Intent Configuration can quickly associate and call intent packages, improving the efficiency and accuracy of AI intent recognition.

messageTemplate.title: You have not created a message template yet. Let's get started!
messageTemplate.desc: Pre-define standardized reply text structures, and support referencing templates and filling in variables at relevant nodes to quickly generate final messages, avoiding repetitive work.

one.title: Create a Message Template
one.desc: Create a template name, select the exception or custom type, and determine the visibility scope.

two.title: Configure Message Body
two.desc: Configure the message body content in JSON format.

three.title: Reference in Workflows
three.desc: Workflow > Exception Node > Select an enabled message template to quickly trigger exception notifications and ensure timely synchronization of workflow issues.

objectManage.title: You have not created an object template yet. Let's get started!
objectManage.desc: Define the field structure to be extracted from text, for reference by the object extraction node in workflows to achieve automated data extraction.

one.title: Create an Object Template
one.desc: Fill in the object name, set object variables, and define the identifiers and properties of the structured data.

two.title: Reference in Workflows
two.desc: Support importing object templates in workflow global configuration – memory variables, start node, object extraction node – to accurately extract and structure the required business data.

customManage.title: You have not created a model provider yet. Let's get started!
customManage.desc: Configure API endpoints for third-party or private models to meet model invocation needs in specific scenarios.

one.title: Create a Model Provider
one.desc: Fill in the model provider information and submit for confirmation.

two.title: Create a Model Service
two.desc: After creating the model provider, create a model service under the provider and fill in the service information.

three.title: Model Debugging
three.desc: Execute test cases to verify the availability, accuracy, and performance of the model service to ensure it meets the requirements for going live.

routeManage.title: You have not created a routing strategy yet. Let's get started!
routeManage.desc: Configure fault-tolerant rules for model calls to ensure smooth switching to a backup model when the service is abnormal.

one.title: Create a New Routing Strategy
one.desc: Configure the routing rules for model services, fill in the strategy basic information, select the target model group, and set the strategy parameters.

two.title: Set Debug Parameters / Preview Debug Effect
two.desc: Configure debug parameters and perform multiple rounds of debugging to achieve the desired preview effect.

three.title: Use the Model Strategy
three.desc: In the model configuration of the agent, select the created routing strategy.

memory.create.guide.title: You don't have a memory library yet, let's start creating one!
memory.create.guide.describe: As the memory center of the agent, the memory library can effectively extract and integrate context information to form the memory content of the agent.
memory.create.guide.step1.title: Create and configure the library
memory.create.guide.step1.des: As the memory center of an agent, the memory library can be created on the console and configured with short-term and long-term memory policies to effectively extract and integrate context information, and manage the entire lifecycle of memory data.
memory.create.guide.step2.title: Intelligent Twins application association memory library.
memory.create.guide.step2.des: Supports the association of a workflow, and multi-agent with the memory library, automatically summarizes conversations, extracts instructions and user profiles, and stores them for a long time to achieve more accurate personalized responses.
